paragraphs.text: Rammed earth is one of the oldest building methods in the world. Sections of the Great Wall of China were built with it, and in parts of North Africa and southern Europe houses made this way have stood for several hundred years. After a long period of neglect, the technique is attracting interest again from architects looking for low-carbon materials.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The basic material is a mixture of sand, gravel and clay, with just enough water to hold it together. The mixture is placed in layers about 15 centimetres deep inside a temporary wooden frame called formwork. Each layer is then pressed down, traditionally with a heavy wooden tool and today usually with a machine, until it is roughly half its original depth.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: When the wall reaches the top of the formwork, the frame is removed and moved up or along. The fresh wall can be left exposed at once, but it takes up to two years to dry completely. Many modern builders add a small amount of cement, usually between five and ten per cent, to make the wall stronger and more resistant to rain.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: The walls are heavy and thick, typically 30 to 60 centimetres, and this gives them useful properties. They absorb heat during the day and release it slowly at night, which keeps indoor temperatures steady. They also regulate humidity, because the clay absorbs moisture from the air when it is damp and releases it when the air is dry.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: There are disadvantages. Building by hand is slow and needs a large team, and the method depends on suitable soil being available close to the site, since transporting heavy materials over long distances would cancel out much of the environmental benefit. In cold climates, the walls also need an extra layer of insulation.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: a mixture of sand, gravel and clay

explanation.en: “a mixture of sand, gravel and clay” → clay. “Water” is also added, but the note continues the list “sand, gravel and …”.
explanation.kk: «a mixture of sand, gravel and clay» → clay. «Water» да қоспаға кіреді, бірақ жазбада «sand, gravel and …» тізбегі жалғасады.
explanation.ru: «a mixture of sand, gravel and clay» → clay. «Water» тоже входит в смесь, но в заметке продолжается перечень «sand, gravel and …».

items.quote: a temporary wooden frame called formwork

explanation.en: “a temporary wooden frame called formwork” → formwork, one word with no space.
explanation.kk: «a temporary wooden frame called formwork» → formwork, бір сөз, бос орынсыз.
explanation.ru: «a temporary wooden frame called formwork» → formwork, одним словом, без пробела.

items.quote: until it is roughly half its original depth
items.prompt: Each layer is pressed to about half its original 3 ____

explanation.en: “roughly half its original depth” → depth. “About” = “roughly”. “Centimetres” does not fit: after “original” we need the dimension.
explanation.kk: «roughly half its original depth» → depth. «About» = «roughly». «Centimetres» келмейді: «original» сөзінен кейін өлшемнің атауы керек.
explanation.ru: «roughly half its original depth» → depth. «About» = «roughly». «Centimetres» не подходит: после «original» нужно существительное-измерение.

items.quote: to make the wall stronger and more resistant to rain
items.prompt: Cement makes walls stronger and more resistant to 4 ____

explanation.en: “to make the wall stronger and more resistant to rain” → rain. Cement is added for strength and protection from rain; “stronger” is already in the note, and the gap follows “resistant to”.
explanation.kk: «to make the wall stronger and more resistant to rain» → rain. Цементті беріктік пен жаңбырдан қорғау үшін қосады; «stronger» жазбада тұр, бос орын «resistant to» сөзінен кейін.
explanation.ru: «to make the wall stronger and more resistant to rain» → rain. Цемент добавляют ради прочности и защиты от дождя; «stronger» уже стоит в заметке, пропуск — после «resistant to».

groups.title: Rammed earth: materials and method
groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Complete the notes below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer.

items.quote: placed in layers about 15 centimetres deep
items.prompt: Depth of each layer: about 5 ____ centimetres

explanation.en: “layers about 15 centimetres deep” → 15. “30 to 60 centimetres” is the wall thickness, already in the table.
explanation.kk: «layers about 15 centimetres deep» → 15. «30 to 60 centimetres» — қабырғаның қалыңдығы, ол кестеде тұр.
explanation.ru: «layers about 15 centimetres deep» → 15. «30 to 60 centimetres» — толщина стены, она уже в таблице.

items.quote: it takes up to two years to dry completely
items.prompt: Time to dry completely: up to 6 ____ years

explanation.en: “takes up to two years to dry completely” → two (or 2). “Several hundred years” in paragraph A is the age of houses.
explanation.kk: «takes up to two years to dry completely» → two (немесе 2). A абзацындағы «several hundred years» — үйлердің жасы.
explanation.ru: «takes up to two years to dry completely» → two (или 2). «Several hundred years» из абзаца A — возраст домов.

items.quote: usually between five and ten per cent
items.prompt: Cement content: between 7 ____ and ten per cent

explanation.en: “between five and ten per cent” → five (or 5). “Ten” is already in the table.
explanation.kk: «between five and ten per cent» → five (немесе 5). «Ten» кестеде тұр.
explanation.ru: «between five and ten per cent» → five (или 5). «Ten» уже стоит в таблице.

groups.title: Key figures
groups.instruction: Questions 5–7. Complete the table below. Choose ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.

items.quote: They absorb heat during the day and release it slowly at night
items.prompt: During the day, the walls absorb 8 ____

explanation.en: “absorb heat during the day” → heat. “Moisture” is also absorbed, but that is humidity and the last step of the chart.
explanation.kk: «absorb heat during the day» → heat. «Moisture» да «absorbs» етістігімен келеді, бірақ ол ылғал туралы, схеманың соңғы қадамы.
explanation.ru: «absorb heat during the day» → heat. «Moisture» тоже «absorbs», но это про влажность и последний шаг схемы.

explanation.en: “which keeps indoor temperatures steady” → steady. The chart says “stay”, the text “keeps … steady”: the meaning is the same, and the word is copied unchanged.
explanation.kk: «which keeps indoor temperatures steady» → steady. Схемада «stay» етістігі, мәтінде «keeps … steady»: мағынасы бірдей, ал бос орынға сөзді мәтіннен өзгертпей аламыз.
explanation.ru: «which keeps indoor temperatures steady» → steady. В схеме глагол «stay», в тексте «keeps … steady»: смысл одинаковый, а слово в пропуск берём из текста без изменений.

items.quote: the clay absorbs moisture from the air when it is damp
items.prompt: In damp weather, the clay absorbs 10 ____ from the air

explanation.en: “the clay absorbs moisture from the air when it is damp” → moisture. “Humidity” is the general idea at the start of the sentence; after “absorbs” the text has “moisture”.
explanation.kk: «the clay absorbs moisture from the air when it is damp» → moisture. «Humidity» — сөйлем басындағы жалпы ұғым, ал мәтінде «absorbs» сөзінен кейін «moisture» тұр.
explanation.ru: «the clay absorbs moisture from the air when it is damp» → moisture. «Humidity» — общее понятие из начала предложения, а после «absorbs» в тексте стоит «moisture».
